usage: Use 整應用程式 for the activity of making or building an app, especially in a tech or coding context.
It sounds natural when talking about software projects, side projects, or learning to code.
This word focuses on the process of creating an app, not on using an app or downloading one.
In everyday speech, people may also say 做 app or 整 app, which can sound more casual than the full phrase.
